title: Linear algebra practice
targetPerformance: By hour 20, solve at least 16 of 20 fresh 2D vector and 2x2 matrix tasks in 45 minutes, predict orientation and area changes, verify an eigenpair, and write loop-based transformation functions that pass all assertions.
whyItMatters: Read matrix operations as changes to space and check small models without a black-box library.

subskills.title: Vectors as arrows
subskills.selfCorrection: Sketch the arrow and check component signs.
drills: Compute a length and a dot product.

subskills.title: Linear combinations and span
subskills.why: See which destinations can be reached.
subskills.selfCorrection: Test whether candidate directions are parallel.

subskills.title: Matrices as transformations
subskills.why: Read columns as transformed basis arrows.
subskills.selfCorrection: Apply the matrix to each unit basis vector.

subskills.title: Composition and multiplication
subskills.why: Track the order of two transformations.
drills: Multiply by hand with rows and columns.

subskills.title: Determinant as signed area scale
subskills.selfCorrection: Check area magnitude separately from orientation.
drills: Find the area of a transformed region.

subskills.title: Inverse transformations
subskills.why: Undo only maps that preserve information.
subskills.selfCorrection: Multiply the candidate inverse back to identity.

subskills.title: Eigenvectors and eigenvalues
subskills.why: Find directions that stay on their own line.
subskills.selfCorrection: Check Av=lambda v with a nonzero v.

subskills.title: Build transformation models
subskills.selfCorrection: Check basis vectors and an independent test point.

resources.title: 3Blue1Brown — Essence of linear algebra
resources.why: Geometric lessons on basis vectors, determinants, and eigenvectors; watch after attempting each subskill.

resources.title: Khan Academy — Linear algebra
resources.why: Free videos and exercises for vectors, matrix products, and inverses.

resources.title: MIT OpenCourseWare — 18.06SC Linear Algebra
resources.why: Problem-solving videos and problem sets with solutions for determinants and eigenvalues.

barriers.fix: Attempt one prompt before consulting one short resource section.
Sketch or describe the quantities, predict sign and scale, then compute.
Record the failed assumption, use the next hint, and retry with changed numbers.
